description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys component, specifically testing the creation of key sessions within the Rialto media server environment. It defines a test fixture class and two test cases: one for successful creation and one for failure due to OCDM system failure.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysCreateKeySessionTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysTestBase, used to test the creation of media key sessions in the Rialto server environment.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysCreateKeySessionTest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes media keys with the Netflix key system.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaKeysCreateKeySessionTest
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up media keys.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test case verifying that CreateKeySession successfully creates a session and returns a valid key id.

methods.name: OcdmSystemFailure
methods.description: Test case verifying that CreateKeySession fails appropriately when OCDM creation fails.
